Two floors of readings in one Manhattan building

Psychic Center of New York is the guide to where Namaste readings actually happen: two reading spots on the ground floor of Namaste Bookshop, and three private rooms in the Namaste Healing Center on the 11th floor upstairs.

Downstairs or upstairs?

The shop floor has the bustle of the bookshop around you. The Healing Center rooms have doors that close. Each reader has a usual space, and your booking confirmation says where to go.

What happens here

Tarot, psychic and mediumship readings, astrology, oracle and Lenormand, hypnotherapy and short energy-cleansing sessions. See all sessions.
